'''Indeaf''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] added in v1.10.0 of SRP. While active, movement inputs (forward/back/jump) are forcibly disabled and horizontal motion is continually cancelled, effectively rooting the host in place.

Indeaf does not stack.
